text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder had been left in the dust by 
Special Week. Yet, she quietly muttered 
that she had no regrets about the outcome.

Captivated by her running, countless 
spectators eagerly anticipated her next 
race.

After the race, El Condor Pasa visited 
Grass Wonder to throw down the gauntlet 
yet again.

Grass Wonder took on that challenge 
head-on.

The stage of the showdown would be the 
Mainichi Okan, where Silence Suzuka was 
also set to run... One could sense an 
intensely heated battle on the horizon.
